title: Pods workspace: connect the Mitteilungen tab to the account inbox
goal: Desktop and browser workspace show the owner's real Pod messages from the account inbox and keep read/archived state in sync with the phone inbox.
summary: The Mitteilungen tab exists in the Vite demo only. Add bounded relay read/mark endpoints for the browser session and the signed desktop runtime, parse messages at the trust boundary, and enable the tab on both hosts. Read and archived state stays authoritative in the relay inbox.

problem.statement: Pods already send messages with context.notify, but the workspace can only show demo data.
problem.impact: Owners must switch to the phone inbox to read results, and the new tab stays hidden in the real app.
problem.approach: Read and mark messages through new bounded relay endpoints, validated in one shared contract.
problem.outcome: A notify from a Pod appears in the desktop and browser tab, and marking it read is visible on the phone.

approval.reference: Owner in the implementation session after reviewing revision 4: "ja - du kannst mit der umsetzung starten"

context: The UI was iterated in the Vite demo mode (apps/openape-pods docs/ui-development.md) on branch worktree/openape-pods-ui-redesign-7b2382. Owner decisions in that session: first build the UI with demo data, show messages as a third tab next to Automatisierungen and Entscheidungen, and connect real data afterwards in a planned step. The existing inbox plan (Reports document 01M4B5Q1Q0W6C97A4ZXTFZ5WJR, issue 1446) makes the relay inbox authoritative for messages: they stay readable while the Mac is offline, carry unread state, and reading a message never decides anything.
scope: Relay: read and mark endpoints for messages, for the workspace browser session and for the signed desktop runtime.
Shared contract: parseInboxMessages and parseInboxMessagesCommand in apps/openape-pods/src/contracts/inbox.ts.
Desktop: IPC channel messages from preload through main to the remote controller.
UI completion: paging, unavailable/stale state, tests and documentation of the existing tab.
nonGoals: Per-Pod mute or push settings in the workspace; they stay in the phone inbox.
Showing the local inbox_outbox delivery queue as messages.
Native macOS notifications from the desktop app.
Changing the notify producer contract or the relay item schema.

milestones.title: Relay message endpoints
milestones.goal: Bounded owner and runtime access to messages without touching decisions.
steps: Add InboxStore.messages(owner, { archived, before }) and InboxStore.markMessage(owner, id, change) in apps/openape-pods-relay/server/utils/inbox-store.ts; markMessage sets read, archived or deleted (the existing tombstone, as in the phone inbox) and refuses decisions and already deleted items.
Add GET /api/workspace/v1/messages and POST /api/workspace/v1/messages (mark) with workspaceOwner, including the existing origin check for non-GET.
Add POST /api/runtime/v1/inbox/messages with actor() and a body { type: 'list' | 'mark' } for all messages of the registration's owner account.
acceptance: Relay tests prove list paging (50 per page), archived filter, read/archived marking, refusal of decision IDs and refusal of another owner's item.
Marking through the new endpoints changes the same items the phone inbox reads, including the badge count.
A message deleted in the workspace disappears from the phone inbox after its next sync and never reappears.
milestones.rollback: The endpoints are additive; remove the routes and store methods. No schema migration is involved.
milestones.proof: InboxStore.messages() plus POST /api/workspace/v1/messages and POST /api/runtime/v1/inbox/messages on PR 448 (head 7c7cb7cf). Store, controller and e2e refusal tests pass; Test Run: https://report.openape.ai/d/01M4ZJ5P0Q9B6CA57CGM35D2HP?v=1

milestones.title: Shared message contract
milestones.goal: Every host validates messages at its trust boundary with one parser.
steps: Add parseInboxMessages (page with next cursor) and parseInboxMessagesCommand to contracts/inbox.ts, extending InboxMessagesCommand with an optional archived filter and before cursor.
Enforce the notify limits: title up to 300 characters, body up to 64 KiB, at most five https links without credentials, normalized tags.
acceptance: Contract tests reject unknown fields, non-https or credentialed links, oversize text and decision items.
milestones.rollback: Revert the parser; the demo keeps its local data.
milestones.proof: parseInboxMessage, parseInboxMessagePage and parseInboxMessagesCommand in contracts/inbox.ts, used by relay routes, desktop main, preload, browser client and demo.

milestones.title: Desktop connection
milestones.goal: The registered desktop shows the account's messages from the relay.
steps: Add a messages channel to the IPC channel list, the preload bridge (parsing results) and the main process handler.
Add RemoteController.messages(command) using the existing signed POST; return null while the desktop is not registered with an account.
In localWorkspaceAccess read messages every tenth poll (about every 10 s) and immediately after a mark, like codex and secrets, instead of every second.
acceptance: adapter-contracts tests cover the IPC client with a transport double, including not-registered (no tab) and relay failure (last list kept, error shown).
The packaged desktop shows a real notify message and the read state reaches the phone inbox.
milestones.rollback: Remove the bridge channel; the tab disappears because the host supplies no messages.
milestones.proof: Relay prod-2d24afe9 and the signed desktop build from main 2d24afe9 are installed. A real context.notify message appeared in the desktop and browser tab; marking it read in the browser lowered the phone badge count on the server (47 to 46) and reached the desktop after its next refresh. Rollout Test Run: https://report.openape.ai/d/01M4ZW16SJ0EK0VM09VZZQ3PCW?v=1

milestones.title: Browser workspace connection
milestones.goal: The relay /workspace page shows all of the owner's messages.
steps: Extend browserWorkspaceClient with messages() and markMessage() for /api/workspace/v1/messages, and browserWorkspaceAccess with the messages capability.
Keep messages readable while the desktop is offline, because they come from the relay, not from the runtime.
acceptance: Relay e2e test: a published message appears under /workspace, and marking it read changes /inbox/api/v1/badge.
milestones.rollback: Remove the client methods; the browser tab disappears.
milestones.proof: Relay e2e on the built relay with real fixture IdP, signed desktop runtime and Chrome: 2/2 passed. Test Run: https://report.openape.ai/d/01M4ZJ5P0Q9B6CA57CGM35D2HP?v=1

milestones.title: Finish the tab
milestones.goal: The demo-approved design handles real volumes and failures.
steps: Add 'Load more' with the before cursor for inbox and archive, and a stale/unavailable note that keeps the last list.
Add a browser layout test for the tab (unread badge, mark read, archive, empty state, phone width) and extend demo.test.ts.
Document the messages scenario data and host behavior in docs/ui-development.md.
acceptance: Focused browser and unit suites pass, and screenshots at desktop and phone width have been inspected.
milestones.rollback: Revert the UI commit; the endpoints stay harmless.
milestones.proof: Load older messages, update-error note, layout test at 390/1440 px (64/64 browser tests) and docs in docs/ui-development.md.

decisions.title: Archive all, and delete from the archive
decisions.description: The inbox offers mark all as read and archive all, each after a confirmation that names the count. In the archive each message offers delete, with inline confirmation, instead of mark as unread. Deleting is final for the account.
decisions.reference: Owner, 2026-10-15: "wir brauchen auch alle archivieren und aus dem archiv statt 'Als ungelesen markieren' dann ein löschen"

decisions.title: The relay inbox is authoritative
decisions.description: Read and archived state lives only in the relay, as decided in the inbox plan (issue 1446). The local outbox is a delivery queue, not a message list.
decisions.reference: Inbox plan 01M4B5Q1Q0W6C97A4ZXTFZ5WJR; owner choice in this session: UI first with demo data, real data afterwards.

decisions.title: Third tab, shown only with a messages capability
decisions.description: The tab appears when the host supplies messages, so hosts without the channel stay unchanged during rollout.
decisions.reference: Owner choice in this session: "Dritter Tab (Recommended)".

decisions.title: Desktop sees all of the account's messages
decisions.description: The desktop is registered at pods.openape.ai as a device of the owner's account and acts for that account, so its tab shows the same messages as the browser workspace and the phone inbox.
decisions.reference: Owner, 2026-10-15: "die desktop app ist als mein account angemeldet - das soll ja auch so sein"

risks.title: Accidental deletion
risks.mitigation: Delete is offered only in the archive and asks inline for confirmation. Bulk actions only mark read or archive, ask for confirmation with the count, and apply only to the messages counted in that question.

risks.title: Polling load on the relay
risks.mitigation: Read messages about every 10 s and after marks, not on the 1 s workspace poll; the page size stays 50.

risks.title: Untrusted message content
risks.mitigation: Parse every response with the shared contract, render text without HTML and allow only https links.

risks.title: A device registration can read all messages
risks.mitigation: The endpoint only lists and marks message items of the registration's owner, never decisions; revoking the device at pods.openape.ai removes the access.

verification: pnpm --filter @openape/pods typecheck, test (workspace, adapter-contracts, i18n) and test:browser
Manual end to end: a Pod sends context.notify; the message appears in the desktop and browser tab; marking it read clears the phone badge. Publish the results with screenshots as a Test Run report.
handoff: Done: relay prod-2d24afe9 deployed, signed desktop 2d24afe9 installed with paired backup, live acceptance published. Follow-ups outside this plan: stale DMG acceptance navigation since #1468, about 2.5 minutes read-state sync on a background desktop window, cached 'no execution slot' MCP run results and a GUI self-relaunch during install backup.

sections.title: Current state and relevant code
sections.body:
**Producer:** Pod scripts call `context.notify({ key, title, body, links })`; `apps/openape-pods/src/worker/inbox/outbox.ts` queues it, and `src/main/remote/controller.ts` delivers it signed to `POST /api/runtime/v1/inbox`.

**Relay:** `apps/openape-pods-relay/server/utils/inbox-store.ts` stores items (`kind` message or decision, `runtime_id`, `read`, `archived`). The phone reads them through `/inbox/api/v1/items` with an inbox device session that only an inbox sign-in creates; the workspace cookie does not grant it.

**Demo UI (this session):** `InboxMessage` and `InboxMessagesCommand` in `src/contracts/inbox.ts`, optional `PodsBridge.messages`, `WorkspaceAccess.messages`, `central/MessagesInbox.vue` (mark all read, archive all, delete with confirmation in the archive), the tab in `AutomationsShell.vue`, demo data in `demo/scenarios.ts` and `demo/adapter.ts`.

**Signed runtime requests** are POST-only in the controller, so the runtime endpoint takes a command body instead of GET query parameters.

eslint on changed files: no findings
Browser pane (127.0.0.1:5479, scenario everyday): mark read cleared the tab badge; archive moved the item to Archiv.
Revision 3 UI: archive all (5) emptied the inbox and archive showed 6; delete asked "Endgültig löschen?" and, confirmed, left 5 archived messages. typecheck, eslint and 24 focused tests passed again.
Revision 4 UI: "Alle archivieren" asked "Alle 5 Mitteilungen archivieren?"; Abbrechen kept 5 messages; "Alle 2 Mitteilungen als gelesen markieren?" confirmed left 0 unread and no tab badge.

changelog.text: Revision 1 drafted after the demo UI iteration.
Revision 2: the desktop reads all of the account's messages (owner decision); runtime scoping removed.
Revision 3: archive all and delete from the archive (owner request); deleting moved from non-goals into scope; demo UI implemented and checked.
Revision 4: bulk actions ask for confirmation (owner request).

Implementation on PR 448. Deviations: one POST route per host for list and mark instead of GET plus POST (one shared handler and parser); geometry checks stay in browser layout tests per the inbox UI test migration (issue 1485).
Rollout: relay prod-2d24afe9 and signed desktop 2d24afe9 deployed after separate owner approvals; desktop milestone completed by live acceptance; plan done (achieved).

entries.source: Archive all, and delete from the archive

entries.source: The inbox offers mark all as read and archive all, each after a confirmation that names the count. In the archive each message offers delete, with inline confirmation, instead of mark as unread. Deleting is final for the account.
entries.text: Der Posteingang bietet „Alle als gelesen markieren“ und „Alle archivieren“, jeweils nach einer Nachfrage mit der Anzahl. Im Archiv bietet jede Mitteilung „Löschen“ mit Inline-Bestätigung statt „Als ungelesen markieren“. Löschen gilt endgültig für den Account.

entries.source: Read and archived state lives only in the relay, as decided in the inbox plan (issue 1446). The local outbox is a delivery queue, not a message list.
entries.text: Der Status gelesen/archiviert liegt nur im Relay, wie im Inbox-Plan (Issue 1446) entschieden. Die lokale Outbox ist eine Zustell-Warteschlange, keine Mitteilungsliste.

entries.source: Current state and relevant code
entries.text: Ist-Stand und relevanter Code

entries.source:
**Producer:** Pod scripts call `context.notify({ key, title, body, links })`; `apps/openape-pods/src/worker/inbox/outbox.ts` queues it, and `src/main/remote/controller.ts` delivers it signed to `POST /api/runtime/v1/inbox`.

**Relay:** `apps/openape-pods-relay/server/utils/inbox-store.ts` stores items (`kind` message or decision, `runtime_id`, `read`, `archived`). The phone reads them through `/inbox/api/v1/items` with an inbox device session that only an inbox sign-in creates; the workspace cookie does not grant it.

**Demo UI (this session):** `InboxMessage` and `InboxMessagesCommand` in `src/contracts/inbox.ts`, optional `PodsBridge.messages`, `WorkspaceAccess.messages`, `central/MessagesInbox.vue` (mark all read, archive all, delete with confirmation in the archive), the tab in `AutomationsShell.vue`, demo data in `demo/scenarios.ts` and `demo/adapter.ts`.

**Signed runtime requests** are POST-only in the controller, so the runtime endpoint takes a command body instead of GET query parameters.
entries.text:
**Producer:** Pod-Scripts rufen `context.notify({ key, title, body, links })` auf; `apps/openape-pods/src/worker/inbox/outbox.ts` reiht die Mitteilung ein, und `src/main/remote/controller.ts` stellt sie signiert an `POST /api/runtime/v1/inbox` zu.

**Relay:** `apps/openape-pods-relay/server/utils/inbox-store.ts` speichert Items (`kind` message oder decision, `runtime_id`, `read`, `archived`). Das Handy liest sie über `/inbox/api/v1/items` mit einer Inbox-Gerätesitzung, die nur eine Inbox-Anmeldung anlegt; das Workspace-Cookie reicht dafür nicht.

**Demo-UI (diese Session):** `InboxMessage` und `InboxMessagesCommand` in `src/contracts/inbox.ts`, optionales `PodsBridge.messages`, `WorkspaceAccess.messages`, `central/MessagesInbox.vue` (alle gelesen, alle archivieren, Löschen mit Bestätigung im Archiv), der Tab in `AutomationsShell.vue`, Demo-Daten in `demo/scenarios.ts` und `demo/adapter.ts`.

**Signierte Runtime-Anfragen** gibt es im Controller nur als POST; der Runtime-Endpunkt bekommt deshalb einen Command-Body statt GET-Parametern.
